correctness.rationale: The vertex matrix I+wS has determinant 1−w^4. The primitive coordinate-sum quotient contributes w+1, so the remaining determinant gives the proposed normalized 3-volume. Stars and bars applied to the prior count gives h1; shifted reciprocity gives h3=h1; subtracting from the volume gives h2. In the original self-contained count I also checked the barycentric extremal vectors and that an integral point with a zero coordinate is a vertex. Independently expanded both shifted inequality certificates and computed all four exceptional cubic discriminants. The strict signs at 0, 2/a, 1 and infinity locate three distinct roots for w≥7; w=2 is a separate quadratic. b>a reduces each coefficient property to the stated one-inequality test and hence the stated cutoff. Non-IDP follows from the same-model theorem, not from finite computation.
residual_risks: No extension to nonuniform weights or other cycle sizes is asserted; the finite checks do not certify the all-weight proof.
